prompt: What concern does the woman report?
evidence: one person says the tubs themselves were included.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: one person says the tubs themselves were included.

options.text: Two tubs were sent to the wrong station.
options.zh: 兩個桶子送到錯的工作區。
options.whyZh: 她談的是秤重是否包含空桶，不是桶送到哪裡。

options.text: The reported amounts may include the tubs.
options.zh: 回報數字可能把桶子的重量算進去。
options.whyZh: 女方說有人認為回報的重量把桶子本身也包含了。

options.text: The two stations used different units.
options.zh: 兩區使用了不同的重量單位。
options.whyZh: 八和五都是公斤；問題不是重量單位不一致。

options.text: The report has been delivered a day late.
options.whyZh: 數字已列入明天的報告，沒有說報告遲交。

explanationZh: 女方說有人認為回報的重量把桶子本身也包含了。

vocabulary.note: 指數字可能把原本不該列入的空桶算進去了。
